actions.add_form_response.description:
Submits a new response programmatically to a form. 
**Note:** This does **not** trigger email notifications to the form admin, unlike regular public submissions.
actions.add_form_response.props.response: Key-value pairs where each key is the field UUID and the value is the user input.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.get_all_forms.description: Lists all forms in your workspace, including their fields.
actions.get_form_fields.description: Retrieves only the fields of a specific form. Great for understanding the structure before building automations.
actions.get_form_responses.description: Retrieves all submissions (responses) for a specific form. Useful for reporting and data exports.
actions.get_submission_pdf.description: Generates a PDF download link for a specific form submission by its unique response UUID.
actions.get_submission_pdf.props.respons: The unique identifier of the submission. You can find this in the form responses list.
actions.get_workspace_details.descriptio: Retrieves all information about your Deftform workspace. Useful as a connection test.
actions.update_form_settings.description: Updates any combination of form settings via a single call — from title and status to integrations, SEO, and security.
actions.update_form_settings.props.admin: Attach a PDF version of the submission to the admin email.
Custom note added to the top of the admin notification email.
Subject line of the email sent to admins on each new submission.
actions.update_form_settings.props.after: Message shown on screen after the user submits the form.
Message sent to the respondent in their confirmation email (if enabled).
Subject line of the confirmation email sent to the respondent.
Number of seconds to wait before redirecting. Leave empty for instant redirect.
URL to redirect the respondent to after submission (instead of showing a message).
actions.update_form_settings.props.aiSum: Enable the AI-powered summary on the form dashboard.
actions.update_form_settings.props.close: Message shown when a user tries to access a closed form.
actions.update_form_settings.props.ctaLa: Text on the primary button shown after submission (e.g. "Download").
Text on the secondary button shown after submission (e.g. "Next").
actions.update_form_settings.props.descr: New description shown on the public form page.
actions.update_form_settings.props.disco: When checked, a notification is sent to the configured Discord channel on each submission.
actions.update_form_settings.props.googl: When checked, submissions are automatically synced to Google Sheets.
actions.update_form_settings.props.hubsp: When checked, submissions are pushed to HubSpot as contacts or deals.
actions.update_form_settings.props.inclu: Include the full response data in the admin notification body.
actions.update_form_settings.props.isClo: When checked, the form stops accepting new submissions.
New display name of the form. Leave empty to keep the current value.
actions.update_form_settings.props.numbe: Text added before the submission number (e.g. "INV-").
Text added after the submission number (e.g. "-A").
actions.update_form_settings.props.respo: Maximum number of submissions allowed. Leave empty for unlimited responses.
actions.update_form_settings.props.sendP: Attach a PDF version of the submission to the respondent confirmation email.
actions.update_form_settings.props.seoAl: When checked, search engines may index the public form page.
actions.update_form_settings.props.seoDe: Meta description for the public form page.
actions.update_form_settings.props.seoTi: Custom HTML title tag for the public form page.
actions.update_form_settings.props.showF: Display the form title at the top of the public page.
actions.update_form_settings.props.showM: Show a progress bar when the form has multiple pages.
actions.update_form_settings.props.slack: When checked, a notification is sent to the configured Slack channel on each submission.
auth.description:
To get your Deftform API key:
1. Log in to your Deftform workspace at https://deftform.com
2. Go to **Settings > API** (https://deftform.com/settings/api)
3. Click **Create API Key**
4. Copy the key and paste it here

Need help? See https://deftform.com/docs/api
description: Build powerful forms and automate your workflow with Deftform.
triggers.new_form_response.description: Triggers instantly when a new response is submitted to a Deftform form.
triggers.new_form_response.props.instruc:
**Setup instructions:**
1. In your Deftform workspace go to **Settings → Notifications / Connections**.
2. Under **Webhook**, click **ADD ENDPOINT** and paste the URL below:
```
{{webhookUrl}}
```
3. Save the endpoint, then open the form you want to watch, go to its **Notifications / Connections** tab, and enable the webhook you just created.
